title: Reducing the cost of SSE-KMS with Amazon S3 Bucket Keys
note: Q1 LW fix (Amendment 3): an S3 Bucket Key is a short-lived, bucket-level KMS data key that S3 reuses across requests instead of calling AWS KMS for every object, cutting SSE-KMS's AWS KMS request costs by up to 99%; it is enabled per bucket (new objects only) or overridden per request with the x-amz-server-side-encryption-bucket-key-enabled header, and it is not supported for DSSE-KMS.
